content.short: Portfel is a TON portfolio tracker for assets, staking, liquidity positions, rewards, vaults, and history.
content.description: Portfel is a portfolio tracker built specifically for TON. Its site and TON App listing describe a dashboard that collects wallet assets, staking, provided liquidity, rewards, open positions, vaults, NFTs, and historical portfolio data in one place. It is useful for users who want a clearer view of TON holdings without checking each protocol separately. Portfel fits developer tooling because it helps teams build, debug, deploy, index, or inspect TON applications more reliably.
